Headline: CDOT Work on Lake St Bridge Extended Thru Tuesday Night/Wednesday morning
ShortDescription: WORK EXTENDED: Lake Street Bridge closed for CDOT reconstruction work; Pink and Green lines interrupted. More: transitchicago.com/lakebridge

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Green Line trains run in two sections:

  • Green Line trains will make all stops between Harlem/Lake and Clinton stations with riders connecting to free bus substitutions between Clinton and Clark/Lake stations.
     
  • Green Line trains will make all stops between Ashland/63rd or Cottage Grove and Loop stations with connection to free bus shuttles between Clark/Lake and Clinton Stations. Trains will make all stops around the entire Loop, following the Orange Line direction and platforms.

Pink Line trains connect to Blue Line-Racine station for connecting service to downtown:

  • Pink line trains will make all stops between 54th/Cermak and Polk stations and then connect to Racine Station where riders will transfer to Blue Line trains for continuing service downtown.
     
  • Pink Line riders going to/from Ashland, Morgan, Clinton stations or West Loop transfer to #9/#X9 Ashland buses near either Polk or Racine stations or other north-south bus routes (free transfer when you tap) to reach the Green Line over Lake St.

For more info about this and related work, visit transitchicago.com/lakebridge

Why this work is extended:
CDOT crews require additional time to complete complex structural, electrical, and mechanical alignments on the newly replaced bridge leaf.

Headline: #79 79th Temporary Reroute at 79th/Stony Island
ShortDescription: #79 79th buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, construction near 79th/Stony Island.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#79 79th buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via 79th, Greenwood, 76th, Stony Island, and 79th then resume their normal route, due to construction near 79th/Stony Island.

Allow extra travel time.
